project: HBL radial energy-critical Hartree Type II blowup with dynamically selected rate

physical_content.actual_monopole_source: two time-integrable normalized projections of the finite-cutoff Hartree-monopole EFFECTIVE increment under the previously audited primitive-path decay bounds
physical_content.approximate_instantaneous_rate: a(s)=1/2+2mu_source(s) tends to 1/2+2mu_source,infty, with no preassigned terminal value

important_limitations: The source-driven mu_source(s) is defined by the effective monopole projected integral; equality to the actual physical modulation mu(s) is NOT established.

The effective residual contains an extra +c(s) V_c(s)^3 relative to the bare radial Hartree residual difference. This is bookkeeping and must be cancelled by actual physical radiation/remote Hartree terms.
The physical two-channel modulation equation, true q b_s+4 b mu source identity, full feedback and pointwise integrable drift for the EXACT PDE solution have not been proved.
No exact Hartree PDE orbit or genuine new Type II solution was constructed by these auxiliary theorems.
Actual blowup main theorem and original 2.12 remain unproved. Original manuscript strict count remains 9/21.
next_load_bearing_requirement: Prove from the actual full three-region Hartree residual and constrained moving-frame equations that q b_s+4b mu equals twice a physically identified integrable forcing, preserving the complete nonlinear and remote radiation terms, then reconstruct the actual solution.
